statement: Specification and design documents, registers, traceability, limitations, the draft change request, and the integrity evidence of the package.
Any implementation code, including reference implementations and test code. The registers describe them; none exists.
M7, the profit improvement engine, Engine #17, E1-E5, M9, AUIF implementation and any Amir handoff.
Luxury-specific valuation, condition, provenance or real luxury data; any real feed, vendor, licence or credential; deployment.
Any connection of a market signal to an APG finding or recommendation; this is blocked until the product owner approves the Section 08 change request.
Locked Sections 00-18, CR-09, the RTM, M6, M8.3 and every preserved release. The RTM v2.2 candidate, CR-11 and CR-01 rev 3 positions are untouched.
DEC-A1-1..8, CR-02 A1..A13 and B7 stay open and untouched.
"Pack" means a data document the core validates; it contains no executable code (MIE-OQ-05).

"Signal" means an observed fact about evidence. "Timing assessment" is an advisory record produced by a pack's decision table from signals, constraints and caller-supplied scenarios. Neither is a forecast.
"Universal" means the core has no domain vocabulary and runs any conforming pack. It does not mean every market behaves alike, and it does not mean one pack suits several fields.

The words price, market, source, licence, level, unit, observation and signal are treated as generic market-intelligence vocabulary and are allowed in the core. The deny-list holds the domain terms of construction, vehicles and watches (see the specification, section 3.2).
Stopping at specification means the test families and mutants listed here are plans. No test has been written or run.

"Market signal" means a signal of type LEVEL_MOVEMENT, CONVERSION_MOVEMENT, AVAILABILITY_CHANGE, VARIANT_INTRODUCED or VARIANT_WITHDRAWN. DATA_STALE, DATA_MISSING and DATA_CONFLICT are data-quality signals (MIE-R-63).

The core never retrieves data. Retrieval, mapping and scheduling belong to an ingestion driver and a feed adapter on the host or integration side; ObservationSourcePort is their contract, not a port of the core. Nothing here decides where they run (MIE-OQ-25).

A recorded disposition in MIE1_OQ_DISPOSITIONS.csv is the position the specification is written to, with its basis. It is not a decision. Questions owned by the product owner show the decision still needed.
The Section 08 change request is still an unnumbered DRAFT. This revision does not approve Option A, Option B or neither.

Signal-influenced and downstream rules. A rule is signal-influenced when it uses a market-signal predicate, whatever its configured outcome. A rule is downstream when any signal-influenced rule stands earlier in the table, whatever that rule's outcome or basis. The pack check and the result class (DIRECT, PRECEDENCE, NONE) use these two definitions and no other (MIE-R-63).

Builder-identified clarifications for the reviewer to contest: a downstream rule whose configured outcome is NOT_ASSESSED is also owner-labelled (no exemption); NO_RULE_MATCHED and NO_TABLE results have class NONE and, for NO_RULE_MATCHED, list the signal-influenced rules evaluated; an unlabelled DIRECT or PRECEDENCE result fails closed (MIE-R-69). None of these is a product-owner decision.

Neither this revision nor the delivered v0.1 and v0.2 packages is closed or implementation-ready. The blockers BLK-01..BLK-03 stay open (MIE-R-70). The Section 08 change request is still an unnumbered DRAFT and no open question is decided.
